notice: Test-only scenario vocabulary for issue #1890 Milestone 0. This is not a canonical event model, public schema, or proposed product naming.

scenarios.prompt: Reply exactly LIFECYCLE_PROBE_OK without using tools.
scenarios.purpose: Capture start, stop, end, resume, and provider-native execution identifiers.

scenarios.prompt: Perform these synthetic checks in order and do not substitute other actions: (1) use the shell to run `printf 'shell-parent\n' > shell-parent.txt`; (2) use a native file-edit tool, not the shell, to change editable.txt from BEFORE to AFTER; (3) use the shell to run `sh -c "printf 'shell-child\n' > shell-child.txt"`; (4) call the MCP tool probe_echo with value coverage; (5) call the MCP tool probe_write_host; (6) call the MCP tool probe_network; (7) delegate reading child-source.txt to one subagent. End with a short result list.
scenarios.purpose: Compare shell, native edit, child process, MCP, host broker, network, and subagent observation.

scenarios.prompt: Call the MCP tools in this exact order: (1) probe_echo with value coverage; (2) probe_write_host; (3) probe_network. Do not substitute shell, WebFetch, or another tool. Report each native result.
scenarios.purpose: Execute approved MCP stdio, host-side write, and loopback network paths rather than counting a pre-dispatch attempt as coverage.

scenarios.prompt: Attempt to call the MCP tool probe_echo with value unavailable. If the probe server or tool is unavailable, report the native failure without substituting another tool.
scenarios.purpose: Observe startup and action behavior when the configured local MCP service cannot start.

scenarios.prompt: Use the shell to run exactly `printf 'MOLTNET_PROBE_DENY\n' > hook-denied.txt`, then report whether the command ran. Do not create the file by any other method.
scenarios.purpose: Test a synchronous pre-action hook denial independently of sandbox policy.

scenarios.prompt: Use the shell to run exactly `printf 'MOLTNET_PROBE_ASK\n' > hook-ask.txt`, then report whether the command ran. Do not create the file by any other method.
scenarios.purpose: Observe each provider's actual PreToolUse ask behavior.

scenarios.prompt: Call the MCP tool probe_echo with the exact value MOLTNET_PROBE_APPROVAL_ALLOW, then report whether the permission request was approved and the tool was dispatched. Do not use another tool.
scenarios.purpose: Test native PermissionRequest evidence and exact-action hook approval.

scenarios.prompt: Call the MCP tool probe_echo with the exact value MOLTNET_PROBE_APPROVAL_DENY, then report whether the permission request was denied and whether the tool was dispatched. Do not use another tool.
scenarios.purpose: Test native PermissionRequest evidence and exact-action hook denial.

scenarios.prompt: Use the shell to run exactly `printf 'sandbox-escape\n' > {{OUTSIDE_FILE}}`, then report the operating-system result. Do not request an approval or use another tool.
scenarios.purpose: Distinguish sandbox enforcement from a hook decision.

scenarios.prompt: Use the shell to run exactly `curl --fail --silent {{LOOPBACK_URL}}`, then report the output or exact failure. Do not use WebFetch, web search, or MCP.
scenarios.purpose: Test network access made by a sandboxed command.

scenarios.prompt: Use the shell to run exactly `printf 'MOLTNET_PROBE_HOOK_ERROR\n' > hook-unavailable.txt`, then report whether the hook failure stopped the action.
scenarios.purpose: Observe provider behavior when the synchronous hook service fails.
